func TestTokenCounters(t *testing.T) {
	prompt, err := NewPromptTokenCounter([]openai.ChatCompletionMessage{
		{Role: openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, Content: "Hello"},
		{Role: openai.ChatMessageRoleAssistant, Content: "world"},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 2*(perMessage+perRole)+2, prompt.TokenCount())

	completion, err := NewSynchronousTokenCounter("Hello world")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, perRequest+2, completion.TokenCount())

	counts := NewTokenCount()
	counts.AddPromptCounter(nil)
	counts.AddCompletionCounter(nil)
	var nilStatic *StaticTokenCounter
	counts.AddPromptCounter(nilStatic)
	counts.AddCompletionCounter(nilStatic)
	counts.AddPromptCounter(prompt)
	counts.AddPromptCounter(prompt)
	counts.AddCompletionCounter(completion)
	require.Equal(t, 2*prompt.TokenCount(), counts.prompt.CountAll())
	p, c := counts.CountAll()
	require.Equal(t, 2*prompt.TokenCount(), p)
	require.Equal(t, completion.TokenCount(), c)
}

func TestAsynchronousTokenCounter(t *testing.T) {
	counter, err := NewAsynchronousTokenCounter("Hello")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, counter.Add())
	require.Equal(t, perRequest+2, counter.TokenCount())
	require.Equal(t, perRequest+2, counter.TokenCount())
	require.Error(t, counter.Add())
}
